Pytest source-pin regression 5/5 passed; broader signup/founder_offer sweep 89 passed with the pre-declared unrelated failure test_iter212m222_signup_created_at::test_admin_list_users_tolerates_both_types (baseline, not caused by this batch).

critical_code_review_comments: FounderOfferPill.jsx: two useEffects each with their own 60s interval — minor duplication but fine. Consider merging so the token-check refresh cycle isn't independent from the counter refresh; not a bug.

Signup phone combines '+91' + ' ' + national → libphonenumber-js normalizes fine, but the space in `${phoneDial} ${nationalNumber}` is brittle for locales that already include a leading 0 (India national 0-prefix) — currently accepted by libphonenumber; not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ prefixed signup accounts via /api/aurem-dev/auth/signup during Bug 3 validation (TEST_nophone_*, TEST_phone_*, TEST_ui_nophone_*, TEST_ui_inphone_*). Safe to leave; prefixed for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs in this batch verified in preview env. FounderOfferPill is now per-user aware and hides for accounts with repos_claimed>0; anonymous Landing shows it normally. AuthShell logo confirmed 'ORA by Aurem' on /signup and /login. Signup h1 = 'Start building, production-ready from day one'. CountryCodeSelect (SELECT tag, default '+1') combines with phone input server-side; Mongo stores E164 like '+919876543210'.
